`HEALTH_PROBE_DEADLINE`, the deadline on a best-effort health read the CLI makes only to copy the daemon's hook log into its local history, before a teardown and after a resume; core makes no such read, and the figure is short so a wedged endpoint can't hold a teardown for the transport's request timeout

`ATTACH_PROBE_DEADLINE`, the deadline on attaching a session only for that hook-log read after a resume; it bounds a CLI history nicety core doesn't do, so a resume whose VM is running never stalls over it

`SYNC_DELETE_GRACE`, how long a sync pass waits past the in-guest `rm`'s own deadline; it's the figure the pass has always used, shorter than core's `DEFAULT_CLIENT_GRACE` because a pass under `sync --watch` holds the next one while it waits, and changing it is a behavior change of its own

the quiet period `sync --watch` waits after a file event so one save's burst of events runs one sync pass; it paces the CLI's interactive watch loop, the terminal affordance the notify placement decision names, and the sync pass it wakes goes to core in #260
`RESIZE_POLL_INTERVAL`, how often the interactive shell re-reads the local terminal's size to send a resize frame; the terminal is the CLI's, and no layer below it has one
